import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_precond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  haystack.size < 1000000 ∧
  patterns.size > 0 ∧
  patterns.size < 1000000 ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < patterns.size → 
    let p := patterns.getD i #[]
    p.size < 1000000)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace ACAuto

/-- A trie (prefix tree) node: the identifiers of the patterns that end at this
node, together with the outgoing edges labelled by bytes. -/
inductive Trie where
  | node : List Nat → List (UInt8 × Trie) → Trie

namespace Trie

def ids : Trie → List Nat
  | .node is _ => is

def children : Trie → List (UInt8 × Trie)
  | .node _ ch => ch

def empty : Trie := .node [] []

end Trie

/-- Look up the child reached by byte `c`. -/
def childOf (c : UInt8) : List (UInt8 × Trie) → Option Trie
  | [] => none
  | (d, t) :: rest => if d = c then some t else childOf c rest

/-- Update (or create) the child labelled `d`, applying `f` to it. -/
def insertChild (d : UInt8) (f : Trie → Trie) : List (UInt8 × Trie) → List (UInt8 × Trie)
  | [] => [(d, f Trie.empty)]
  | (e, t) :: rest => if e = d then (e, f t) :: rest else (e, t) :: insertChild d f rest

/-- Insert the pattern `p`, carrying identifier `id`, into the trie. -/
def Trie.insert : List UInt8 → Nat → Trie → Trie
  | [], id, .node is ch => .node (id :: is) ch
  | d :: p, id, .node is ch => .node is (insertChild d (Trie.insert p id) ch)

/-- Walk down the trie following the bytes of `s`. -/
def Trie.path : Trie → List UInt8 → Option Trie
  | t, [] => some t
  | t, c :: s => (childOf c t.children).bind (fun t' => t'.path s)

/-- Is `s` the label of some node of the trie (i.e. a prefix of some pattern)? -/
def nodeQ (T : Trie) (s : List UInt8) : Bool := (T.path s).isSome

/-- The identifiers of the patterns ending exactly at the node labelled `s`. -/
def endsOf (T : Trie) (s : List UInt8) : List Nat :=
  match T.path s with
  | none => []
  | some t => t.ids

/-- Step 1: trie construction from the pattern set. -/
def build (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) : Trie :=
  (List.range patterns.size).foldl
    (fun t i => t.insert (patterns.getD i #[]).toList i) Trie.empty

/-- Step 2: the failure link of the node labelled `s`: the longest proper suffix
of `s` that is itself a node of the trie. -/
def failOf (T : Trie) : List UInt8 → List UInt8
  | [] => []
  | _ :: t => if nodeQ T t then t else failOf T t

theorem failOf_length_le (T : Trie) : ∀ s : List UInt8, (failOf T s).length ≤ s.length := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [failOf]
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [failOf]
    split
    · simp
    · simp only [List.length_cons]; omega

theorem failOf_length_lt (T : Trie) (s : List UInt8) (h : ¬ s = []) :
    (failOf T s).length < s.length := by
  cases s with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t =>
    simp only [failOf]
    split
    · simp
    · have := failOf_length_le T t
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega

/-- The goto function of the automaton: follow the trie edge if it exists,
otherwise fall back along the failure links. -/
def gotoS (T : Trie) (s : List UInt8) (c : UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
  if nodeQ T (s ++ [c]) then s ++ [c]
  else if h : s = [] then [] else gotoS T (failOf T s) c
termination_by s.length
decreasing_by exact failOf_length_lt T s h

/-- The chain of failure links starting at `s` (all node-suffixes of `s`). -/
def chainOf (T : Trie) (s : List UInt8) : List (List UInt8) :=
  if h : s = [] then [[]] else s :: chainOf T (failOf T s)
termination_by s.length
decreasing_by exact failOf_length_lt T s h

/-- All matches reported when the automaton is in state `s` after having
consumed `i` bytes of the text: walk the failure-link chain and output every
pattern stored on it. -/
def emitAt (T : Trie) (i : Nat) (s : List UInt8) : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  (chainOf T s).flatMap (fun u => (endsOf T u).map (fun pid => (pid, i - u.length)))

/-- Step 3: single pass over the text.  `run T haystack n` is the state after
consuming the first `n` bytes together with all matches found so far. -/
def run (T : Trie) (haystack : Array UInt8) : Nat → List UInt8 × List (Nat × Nat)
  | 0 => ([], emitAt T 0 [])
  | n + 1 =>
    let r := run T haystack n
    let s := gotoS T r.1 (haystack.getD n 0)
    (s, r.2 ++ emitAt T (n + 1) s)

end ACAuto
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def ac_automata_search (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) :
    Array (Nat × Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (ACAuto.run (ACAuto.build patterns) haystack haystack.size).2.toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition auxiliary definitions
def matches_at (haystack : Array UInt8) (needle : Array UInt8) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + needle.size ≤ haystack.size ∧
  (∀ i : Nat, i < needle.size → haystack.getD (start + i) 0 = needle.getD i 0)

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def ac_automata_search_postcond (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))
    (result : Array (Nat × Nat)) (_ : ac_automata_search_precond haystack patterns) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  (∀ i : Nat, i < result.size →
      let pair := result.getD i (0, 0)
      let pid := pair.fst
      let idx := pair.snd
      pid < patterns.size ∧
      -- Removed duplicate `pid < patterns.size` check
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx) ∧
  (∀ pid idx : Nat,
      pid < patterns.size →
      matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx →
      ∃ k : Nat, k < result.size ∧ result.getD k (0, 0) = (pid, idx))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace ACAuto

/-! ### Generic list lemmas -/

theorem suffix_nest {u s w : List UInt8} (hu : u <:+ w) (hs : s <:+ w)
    (hl : u.length ≤ s.length) : u <:+ s := by
  have h1 : u.reverse <+: w.reverse := List.reverse_prefix.mpr hu
  have h2 : s.reverse <+: w.reverse := List.reverse_prefix.mpr hs
  have h3 : u.reverse.length ≤ s.reverse.length := by simpa using hl
  exact List.reverse_prefix.mp (List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le h1 h2 h3)

theorem suffix_snoc_iff {v w : List UInt8} {c : UInt8} :
    v <:+ w ++ [c] ↔ v = [] ∨ ∃ u, u <:+ w ∧ v = u ++ [c] := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases v.eq_nil_or_concat with rfl | ⟨u, b, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
      rw [List.concat_eq_append, ← List.append_assoc] at ha
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := List.append_inj' ha (by simp)
      have hb : b = c := by simpa using h2
      exact Or.inr ⟨u, ⟨a, h1⟩, by simp [hb]⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with rfl | ⟨u, ⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact List.nil_suffix _
    · exact ⟨a, by rw [← List.append_assoc, ha]⟩

theorem suffix_snoc_of_suffix {u w : List UInt8} {c : UInt8} (h : u <:+ w) :
    u ++ [c] <:+ w ++ [c] := suffix_snoc_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨u, h, rfl⟩)

/-! ### Basic trie lemmas -/

theorem path_append (s s' : List UInt8) (T : Trie) :
    T.path (s ++ s') = (T.path s).bind (fun t => t.path s') := by
  induction s generalizing T with
  | nil => simp [Trie.path]
  | cons c s ih => simp [Trie.path, ih, Option.bind_assoc]

theorem nodeQ_nil (T : Trie) : nodeQ T [] = true := by simp [nodeQ, Trie.path]

theorem nodeQ_append_left {T : Trie} {s s' : List UInt8} (h : nodeQ T (s ++ s') = true) :
    nodeQ T s = true := by
  unfold nodeQ at h ⊢
  rw [path_append] at h
  cases hp : T.path s with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; simp at h
  | some t => rw [hp]; rfl

/-! ### Failure links -/

theorem failOf_suffix (T : Trie) : ∀ s : List UInt8, failOf T s <:+ s := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | nil => simp [failOf]
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [failOf]
    split
    · exact List.suffix_cons a t
    · exact ih.trans (List.suffix_cons a t)

theorem failOf_node (T : Trie) : ∀ s : List UInt8, nodeQ T (failOf T s) = true := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | nil => simpa [failOf] using nodeQ_nil T
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [failOf]
    split
    · assumption
    · exact ih

theorem failOf_max (T : Trie) : ∀ (s u : List UInt8), u <:+ s → ¬ u = s →
    nodeQ T u = true → u.length ≤ (failOf T s).length := by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | nil =>
    intro u hsuf hne _
    exact absurd (List.suffix_nil.mp hsuf) hne
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro u hsuf hne hnode
    have hlen1 : u.length ≤ (a :: t).length := hsuf.length_le
    have hlen : u.length ≤ t.length := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge u.length (a :: t).length with h | h
      · simp only [List.length_cons] at h; omega
      · exact absurd (hsuf.eq_of_length (by omega)) hne
    have husuf : u <:+ t := suffix_nest hsuf (List.suffix_cons a t) hlen
    simp only [failOf]
    split
    · exact hlen
    · rename_i hnt
      have hne' : ¬ u = t := by
        intro h; rw [h] at hnode; exact hnt hnode
      exact ih u husuf hne' hnode

/-! ### The failure chain -/

theorem chain_sound (T : Trie) : ∀ (n : Nat) (s u : List UInt8), s.length ≤ n →
    nodeQ T s = true → u ∈ chainOf T s → u <:+ s ∧ nodeQ T u = true := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro s u hn hs hmem
    have hs0 : s = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.mp hn)
    subst hs0
    rw [chainOf] at hmem
    simp at hmem
    subst hmem
    exact ⟨List.nil_suffix _, nodeQ_nil T⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s u hn hs hmem
    by_cases h0 : s = []
    · subst h0
      rw [chainOf] at hmem
      simp at hmem
      subst hmem
      exact ⟨List.nil_suffix _, nodeQ_nil T⟩
    · rw [chainOf] at hmem
      simp only [h0, dif_neg, List.mem_cons] at hmem
      rcases hmem with rfl | hmem
      · exact ⟨List.suffix_refl _, hs⟩
      · have hlt := failOf_length_lt T s h0
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (failOf T s) u (by omega) (failOf_node T s) hmem
        exact ⟨h1.trans (failOf_suffix T s), h2⟩

theorem chain_complete (T : Trie) : ∀ (n : Nat) (s u : List UInt8), s.length ≤ n →
    u <:+ s → nodeQ T u = true → u ∈ chainOf T s := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro s u hn hsuf _
    have hs0 : s = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.mp hn)
    subst hs0
    have : u = [] := List.suffix_nil.mp hsuf
    subst this
    rw [chainOf]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s u hn hsuf hnode
    by_cases h0 : s = []
    · subst h0
      have : u = [] := List.suffix_nil.mp hsuf
      subst this
      rw [chainOf]
      simp
    · by_cases hus : u = s
      · subst hus
        rw [chainOf]
        simp [h0]
      · have hmax := failOf_max T s u hsuf hus hnode
        have hu' : u <:+ failOf T s := suffix_nest hsuf (failOf_suffix T s) hmax
        have hlt := failOf_length_lt T s h0
        rw [chainOf]
        simp only [h0, dif_neg, List.mem_cons]
        exact Or.inr (ih (failOf T s) u (by omega) hu' hnode)

/-! ### The goto function -/

/-- `s` is the longest suffix of `w` that is a node of the trie. -/
def IsLNS (T : Trie) (w s : List UInt8) : Prop :=
  s <:+ w ∧ nodeQ T s = true ∧ ∀ u, u <:+ w → nodeQ T u = true → u.length ≤ s.length

theorem goto_hit (T : Trie) (w s : List UInt8) (c : UInt8)
    (hnode : nodeQ T (s ++ [c]) = true) (hsuf : s <:+ w)
    (hmax : ∀ u, u <:+ w → nodeQ T u = true → s.length < u.length →
      nodeQ T (u ++ [c]) = false) :
    IsLNS T (w ++ [c]) (s ++ [c]) := by
  refine ⟨suffix_snoc_of_suffix hsuf, hnode, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hvnode
  rcases suffix_snoc_iff.mp hv with rfl | ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  · simp
  · have hun : nodeQ T u = true := nodeQ_append_left hvnode
    have : u.length ≤ s.length := by
      by_contra hc
      have := hmax u hu hun (by omega)
      rw [this] at hvnode
      simp at hvnode
    simp only [List.length_append]
    omega

theorem goto_miss_nil (T : Trie) (w : List UInt8) (c : UInt8)
    (hnode : nodeQ T ([] ++ [c]) = false)
    (hmax : ∀ u, u <:+ w → nodeQ T u = true → (0 : Nat) < u.length →
      nodeQ T (u ++ [c]) = false) :
    IsLNS T (w ++ [c]) [] := by
  refine ⟨List.nil_suffix _, nodeQ_nil T, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hvnode
  rcases suffix_snoc_iff.mp hv with rfl | ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  · simp
  · have hun : nodeQ T u = true := nodeQ_append_left hvnode
    have hu0 : u = [] := by
      by_contra hc
      have hpos : 0 < u.length := by
        cases u with
        | nil => exact absurd rfl hc
        | cons a t => simp
      have := hmax u hu hun hpos
      rw [this] at hvnode
      simp at hvnode
    subst hu0
    rw [hnode] at hvnode
    simp at hvnode

theorem goto_spec (T : Trie) (w : List UInt8) (c : UInt8) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (s : List UInt8), s.length ≤ n → nodeQ T s = true → s <:+ w →
      (∀ u, u <:+ w → nodeQ T u = true → s.length < u.length →
        nodeQ T (u ++ [c]) = false) →
      IsLNS T (w ++ [c]) (gotoS T s c) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro s hn _ hsuf hmax
    have hs0 : s = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (Nat.le_zero.mp hn)
    subst hs0
    rw [gotoS]
    by_cases hh : nodeQ T ([] ++ [c]) = true
    · simp only [hh, if_true]
      exact goto_hit T w [] c hh hsuf (by simpa using hmax)
    · have hf : nodeQ T ([] ++ [c]) = false := by
        simpa using hh
      simp only [hf, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, dif_pos]
      exact goto_miss_nil T w c hf (by simpa using hmax)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro s hn hnode hsuf hmax
    rw [gotoS]
    by_cases hh : nodeQ T (s ++ [c]) = true
    · simp only [hh, if_true]
      exact goto_hit T w s c hh hsuf hmax
    · have hf : nodeQ T (s ++ [c]) = false := by simpa using hh
      simp only [hf, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      by_cases h0 : s = []
      · subst h0
        simp only [dif_pos]
        exact goto_miss_nil T w c hf (by simpa using hmax)
      · simp only [h0, dif_neg]
        have hlt := failOf_length_lt T s h0
        refine ih (failOf T s) (by omega) (failOf_node T s)
          ((failOf_suffix T s).trans hsuf) ?_
        intro u hu hun hlen
        rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy u.length s.length with h1 | h1 | h1
        · -- (failOf T s).length < u.length < s.length : contradicts maximality of failOf
          have husuf : u <:+ s := suffix_nest hu hsuf (by omega)
          have hne : ¬ u = s := by
            intro hcon; rw [hcon] at h1; omega
          have := failOf_max T s u husuf hne hun
          omega
        · have : u = s := hu.eq_of_length_of_suffix hsuf h1
          rw [this]
          exact hf
        · exact hmax u hu hun h1

theorem IsLNS_step (T : Trie) (w s : List UInt8) (c : UInt8) (h : IsLNS T w s) :
    IsLNS T (w ++ [c]) (gotoS T s c) := by
  obtain ⟨hsuf, hnode, hmax⟩ := h
  refine goto_spec T w c s.length s le_rfl hnode hsuf ?_
  intro u hu hun hlen
  have := hmax u hu hun
  omega

/-! ### Insertion into the trie -/

theorem endsOf_empty (u : List UInt8) : endsOf Trie.empty u = [] := by
  cases u with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c u => simp [endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.empty, Trie.children, childOf]

theorem childOf_insertChild (c d : UInt8) (f : Trie → Trie) (ch : List (UInt8 × Trie)) :
    childOf c (insertChild d f ch) =
      if c = d then some (f ((childOf d ch).getD Trie.empty)) else childOf c ch := by
  induction ch with
  | nil =>
    by_cases h : c = d
    · subst h
      simp [insertChild, childOf]
    · simp [insertChild, childOf, h, Ne.symm h]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    obtain ⟨e, t⟩ := hd
    by_cases he : e = d
    · subst he
      by_cases h : c = e
      · subst h
        simp [insertChild, childOf]
      · simp [insertChild, childOf, h, Ne.symm h]
    · by_cases h : c = d
      · subst h
        have hec : ¬ e = c := he
        simp [insertChild, childOf, he, hec, ih]
      · simp [insertChild, childOf, he, h, ih]

theorem endsOf_insert : ∀ (p : List UInt8) (id : Nat) (T : Trie) (u : List UInt8),
    endsOf (T.insert p id) u = if u = p then id :: endsOf T u else endsOf T u := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil =>
    intro id T u
    cases T with
    | node is ch =>
      cases u with
      | nil => simp [Trie.insert, endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.ids]
      | cons c u =>
        simp [Trie.insert, endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.children]
  | cons d p ih =>
    intro id T u
    cases T with
    | node is ch =>
      cases u with
      | nil => simp [Trie.insert, endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.ids]
      | cons c u =>
        by_cases h : c = d
        · subst h
          have hchild : childOf c (insertChild c (Trie.insert p id) ch) =
              some ((Trie.insert p id) ((childOf c ch).getD Trie.empty)) := by
            rw [childOf_insertChild]; simp
          simp only [Trie.insert, endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.children, hchild,
            Option.bind_some]
          have hE : endsOf ((Trie.insert p id) ((childOf c ch).getD Trie.empty)) u =
              if u = p then id :: endsOf ((childOf c ch).getD Trie.empty) u
              else endsOf ((childOf c ch).getD Trie.empty) u := ih id _ u
          simp only [endsOf] at hE
          cases hc : childOf c ch with
          | none =>
            simp only [hc, Option.getD_none] at hE
            have := endsOf_empty u
            simp only [endsOf] at this
            simp only [hc, Option.bind_none, List.cons.injEq, List.cons_ne_self]
            simp only [hE, this]
            by_cases hu : u = p <;> simp [hu]
          | some t =>
            simp only [hc, Option.getD_some] at hE
            simp only [hc, Option.bind_some]
            simp only [hE]
            by_cases hu : u = p <;> simp [hu]
        · have hchild : childOf c (insertChild d (Trie.insert p id) ch) = childOf c ch := by
            rw [childOf_insertChild]; simp [h]
          simp only [Trie.insert, endsOf, Trie.path, Trie.children, hchild]
          have : ¬ (c :: u = d :: p) := by simp [h]
          simp [this]

theorem endsOf_insert_mono {p : List UInt8} {id pid : Nat} {T : Trie} {u : List UInt8}
    (h : pid ∈ endsOf T u) : pid ∈ endsOf (T.insert p id) u := by
  rw [endsOf_insert]
  by_cases hu : u = p <;> simp [hu, h]

theorem nodeQ_of_endsOf {T : Trie} {u : List UInt8} {pid : Nat} (h : pid ∈ endsOf T u) :
    nodeQ T u = true := by
  unfold endsOf at h
  unfold nodeQ
  cases hp : T.path u with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; simp at h
  | some t => rw [hp]; rfl

/-! ### Correctness of the trie construction -/

theorem ends_fold_sound (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (T : Trie),
      (∀ i ∈ l, i < patterns.size) →
      (∀ u pid, pid ∈ endsOf T u → pid < patterns.size ∧
        (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList = u) →
      ∀ u pid, pid ∈ endsOf
          (l.foldl (fun t i => t.insert (patterns.getD i #[]).toList i) T) u →
        pid < patterns.size ∧ (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList = u := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro T _ hT u pid hmem; exact hT u pid hmem
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro T hall hT u pid hmem
    refine ih _ (fun i hi => hall i (by simp [hi])) ?_ u pid (by simpa using hmem)
    intro u' pid' hpid'
    rw [endsOf_insert] at hpid'
    by_cases hu : u' = (patterns.getD a #[]).toList
    · subst hu
      simp only [if_pos rfl, List.mem_cons] at hpid'
      rcases hpid' with rfl | hpid'
      · exact ⟨hall a (by simp), rfl⟩
      · exact hT _ _ hpid'
    · simp only [hu, if_false] at hpid'
      exact hT _ _ hpid'

theorem ends_fold_mono (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (T : Trie) (u : List UInt8) (pid : Nat), pid ∈ endsOf T u →
      pid ∈ endsOf (l.foldl (fun t i => t.insert (patterns.getD i #[]).toList i) T) u := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro T u pid h; exact h
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro T u pid h
    exact ih _ u pid (endsOf_insert_mono h)

theorem ends_fold_complete (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (T : Trie) (pid : Nat), pid ∈ l →
      pid ∈ endsOf (l.foldl (fun t i => t.insert (patterns.getD i #[]).toList i) T)
        (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro T pid h; simp at h
  | cons a l ih =>
    intro T pid h
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h
    · refine ends_fold_mono patterns l _ _ _ ?_
      rw [endsOf_insert]
      simp
    · exact ih _ pid h

theorem build_ends_sound (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (u : List UInt8) (pid : Nat)
    (h : pid ∈ endsOf (build patterns) u) :
    pid < patterns.size ∧ (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList = u := by
  refine ends_fold_sound patterns (List.range patterns.size) Trie.empty ?_ ?_ u pid h
  · intro i hi; simpa using hi
  · intro u' pid' hpid'
    rw [endsOf_empty] at hpid'
    simp at hpid'

theorem build_ends_complete (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (pid : Nat)
    (h : pid < patterns.size) :
    pid ∈ endsOf (build patterns) (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList :=
  ends_fold_complete patterns (List.range patterns.size) Trie.empty pid (by simpa using h)

/-! ### Emitting matches -/

theorem emit_mem_of {T : Trie} {i : Nat} {s u : List UInt8} {pid : Nat}
    (hu : u ∈ chainOf T s) (hp : pid ∈ endsOf T u) :
    (pid, i - u.length) ∈ emitAt T i s := by
  simp only [emitAt, List.mem_flatMap]
  exact ⟨u, hu, by simpa using ⟨pid, hp, rfl⟩⟩

theorem emit_of_mem {T : Trie} {i : Nat} {s : List UInt8} {pid idx : Nat}
    (h : (pid, idx) ∈ emitAt T i s) :
    ∃ u, u ∈ chainOf T s ∧ pid ∈ endsOf T u ∧ idx = i - u.length := by
  simp only [emitAt, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, pid', hpid', h1, h2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨u, hu, h1 ▸ hpid', h2.symm⟩

/-! ### Bridging `matches_at` and suffixes of prefixes of the text -/

theorem arr_getD (a : Array UInt8) (k : Nat) (h : k < a.size) : a.getD k 0 = a.toList[k] := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem drop_take_getElem? (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (idx : Nat)
    (hle : idx + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) (j : Nat) :
    ((haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size)).drop idx)[j]? =
      if j < needle.size then haystack.toList[idx + j]? else none := by
  rw [List.getElem?_drop, List.getElem?_take]
  by_cases hj : j < needle.size
  · simp only [hj, if_true]
    have : idx + j < idx + needle.size := by omega
    simp [this]
  · simp only [hj, if_false]
    have : ¬ (idx + j < idx + needle.size) := by omega
    simp [this]

theorem matches_iff_suffix (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (idx : Nat)
    (hle : idx + needle.size ≤ haystack.size) :
    matches_at haystack needle idx ↔
      needle.toList <:+ haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size) := by
  have hlen : (haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size)).length = idx + needle.size := by
    simp only [List.length_take, Array.length_toList]
    omega
  have hkey : (haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size)).drop idx = needle.toList ↔
      ∀ k, k < needle.size → haystack.getD (idx + k) 0 = needle.getD k 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h k hk
      have h1 := drop_take_getElem? haystack needle idx hle k
      rw [h] at h1
      simp only [hk, if_true] at h1
      have hk1 : k < needle.toList.length := by simpa using hk
      have hk2 : idx + k < haystack.toList.length := by
        simp only [Array.length_toList]; omega
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hk2] at h1
      have := Option.some_inj.mp h1
      rw [arr_getD haystack (idx + k) (by simp only [Array.size] at *; omega),
        arr_getD needle k (by simpa using hk)]
      exact this.symm
    · intro h
      apply List.ext_getElem?
      intro j
      rw [drop_take_getElem? haystack needle idx hle j]
      by_cases hj : j < needle.size
      · simp only [hj, if_true]
        have hj1 : j < needle.toList.length := by simpa using hj
        have hj2 : idx + j < haystack.toList.length := by
          simp only [Array.length_toList]; omega
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj1, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj2]
        congr 1
        rw [← arr_getD haystack (idx + j) (by simp only [Array.size] at *; omega),
          ← arr_getD needle j hj]
        exact (h j hj).symm
      · simp only [hj, if_false]
        have : ¬ (j < needle.toList.length) := by simpa using hj
        exact (List.getElem?_eq_none (by simpa using Nat.le_of_not_lt this)).symm
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [List.suffix_iff_eq_drop]
    have : (haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size)).length - needle.toList.length = idx := by
      rw [hlen]; simp; omega
    rw [this]
    exact (hkey.mpr h.2).symm
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hle, ?_⟩
    rw [List.suffix_iff_eq_drop] at h
    have hd : (haystack.toList.take (idx + needle.size)).length - needle.toList.length = idx := by
      rw [hlen]; simp; omega
    rw [hd] at h
    exact hkey.mp h.symm

theorem matches_of_suffix (haystack needle : Array UInt8) (i : Nat) (hi : i ≤ haystack.size)
    (h : needle.toList <:+ haystack.toList.take i) :
    matches_at haystack needle (i - needle.size) := by
  have hlen : (haystack.toList.take i).length = i := by
    simp only [List.length_take, Array.length_toList]; omega
  have hn : needle.size ≤ i := by
    have := h.length_le
    rw [hlen] at this
    simpa using this
  have hidx : (i - needle.size) + needle.size = i := by omega
  rw [matches_iff_suffix haystack needle _ (by omega), hidx]
  exact h

/-! ### The main invariant of the traversal -/

theorem take_succ_eq (haystack : Array UInt8) (n : Nat) (h : n < haystack.size) :
    haystack.toList.take (n + 1) = haystack.toList.take n ++ [haystack.getD n 0] := by
  rw [List.take_succ]
  congr 1
  have h1 : n < haystack.toList.length := by simpa using h
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1]
  simp [arr_getD haystack n h]

theorem emit_sound (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (haystack : Array UInt8) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i ≤ haystack.size) (s : List UInt8)
    (hns : nodeQ (build patterns) s = true)
    (hs : s <:+ haystack.toList.take i) :
    ∀ x ∈ emitAt (build patterns) i s,
      x.1 < patterns.size ∧ matches_at haystack (patterns.getD x.1 #[]) x.2 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨pid, idx⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hpid, hidx⟩ := emit_of_mem hx
  obtain ⟨husuf, _⟩ := chain_sound (build patterns) s.length s u le_rfl hns hu
  obtain ⟨hplt, hpeq⟩ := build_ends_sound patterns u pid hpid
  refine ⟨hplt, ?_⟩
  have h2 : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList <:+ haystack.toList.take i := by
    rw [hpeq]; exact husuf.trans hs
  have h3 := matches_of_suffix haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) i hi h2
  have h4 : (patterns.getD pid #[]).size = u.length := by
    rw [← hpeq]; simp
  simp only []
  rw [hidx, ← h4]
  exact h3

theorem main_inv (patterns : Array (Array UInt8)) (haystack : Array UInt8) :
    ∀ n : Nat, n ≤ haystack.size →
      IsLNS (build patterns) (haystack.toList.take n)
        (run (build patterns) haystack n).1 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ (run (build patterns) haystack n).2,
        x.1 < patterns.size ∧ matches_at haystack (patterns.getD x.1 #[]) x.2) ∧
      (∀ pid idx : Nat, pid < patterns.size →
        matches_at haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx →
        idx + (patterns.getD pid #[]).size ≤ n →
        (pid, idx) ∈ (run (build patterns) haystack n).2) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro hz
    have hrun : run (build patterns) haystack 0 = ([], emitAt (build patterns) 0 []) := rfl
    have hlns : IsLNS (build patterns) (haystack.toList.take 0) [] := by
      refine ⟨List.nil_suffix _, nodeQ_nil _, ?_⟩
      intro u hu _
      simp only [List.take_zero] at hu
      rw [List.suffix_nil.mp hu]
      simp
    refine ⟨by rw [hrun]; exact hlns, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hrun]
      exact emit_sound patterns haystack 0 hz [] (nodeQ_nil _) (by simp)
    · intro pid idx hpid hm hsz
      have hidx : idx = 0 := by omega
      have hsize : (patterns.getD pid #[]).size = 0 := by omega
      have hnil : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList = [] := by
        have : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList.length = 0 := by simpa using hsize
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero this
      have hmem : pid ∈ endsOf (build patterns) [] := by
        have := build_ends_complete patterns pid hpid
        rwa [hnil] at this
      have hch : ([] : List UInt8) ∈ chainOf (build patterns) ([] : List UInt8) := by
        rw [chainOf]; simp
      have := emit_mem_of (T := build patterns) (i := 0) hch hmem
      simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.sub_zero] at this
      rw [hrun, hidx]
      exact this
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hn
    have hn' : n ≤ haystack.size := by omega
    have hnlt : n < haystack.size := by omega
    obtain ⟨hlns, hsound, hcomp⟩ := ih hn'
    set T := build patterns with hT
    set c := haystack.getD n 0 with hc
    have hrun : run T haystack (n + 1) =
        (gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c,
          (run T haystack n).2 ++ emitAt T (n + 1) (gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c)) := rfl
    have htake : haystack.toList.take (n + 1) = haystack.toList.take n ++ [c] :=
      take_succ_eq haystack n hnlt
    have hlns' : IsLNS T (haystack.toList.take (n + 1)) (gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c) := by
      rw [htake]
      exact IsLNS_step T (haystack.toList.take n) (run T haystack n).1 c hlns
    refine ⟨by rw [hrun]; exact hlns', ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hrun]
      intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_append] at hx
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · exact hsound x hx
      · obtain ⟨hs1, hs2, _⟩ := hlns'
        exact emit_sound patterns haystack (n + 1) hn _ hs2 hs1 x hx
    · intro pid idx hpid hm hsz
      rw [hrun]
      simp only [List.mem_append]
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (idx + (patterns.getD pid #[]).size) (n + 1) with hlt | hge
      · exact Or.inl (hcomp pid idx hpid hm (by omega))
      · right
        have heq : idx + (patterns.getD pid #[]).size = n + 1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨hs1, hs2, hs3⟩ := hlns'
        have hsuf : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList <:+ haystack.toList.take (n + 1) := by
          have := (matches_iff_suffix haystack (patterns.getD pid #[]) idx hm.1).mp hm
          rwa [heq] at this
        have hnode : nodeQ T (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList = true :=
          nodeQ_of_endsOf (build_ends_complete patterns pid hpid)
        have hle := hs3 _ hsuf hnode
        have hsub : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList <:+ gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c :=
          suffix_nest hsuf hs1 hle
        have hch := chain_complete T (gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c).length
          (gotoS T (run T haystack n).1 c) (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList le_rfl hsub hnode
        have hmem := emit_mem_of (T := T) (i := n + 1) hch (build_ends_complete patterns pid hpid)
        have hlen : (patterns.getD pid #[]).toList.length = (patterns.getD pid #[]).size := by
          simp
        rw [hlen] at hmem
        have : n + 1 - (patterns.getD pid #[]).size = idx := by omega
        rwa [this] at hmem

end ACAuto

theorem ac_automata_search_postcond_satisfied (haystack : Array UInt8) (patterns : Array (Array UInt8))

      have : L.toArray.getD k (0, 0) = L[k] := by
        simp [Array.getD, hk]
      rw [this, hkeq]
  -- !benchmark @end proof
